Lessons.Title: Pounds and Ounces
ExplanationParagraphs: Learning goal: You will make sense of the relative size of pounds and ounces and to express pounds in terms of ounces.
Core relationship: Pounds and ounces. Use the customary relation 1 pound = 16 ounces before comparing or adding masses.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  Notice and Wonder: A Recipe	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Pounds and Ounces	 (20 minutes); Activity 2:  Party Prep	 (15 minutes); Cool-down:  Hungry Birds	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: How many ounces are in 3 pounds?
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): Express 40 ounces as pounds and ounces.
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
